edits.old: Then the change is refused and nothing changes
edits.new:
Then the change is refused and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC6 Vocabulary and personal data (not a legacy criterion; BR8 and BR9)
    Given the legal action LA-2026-000501 is written with the action type "NOTICE"
    When the decision record and the legal action are written
    Then the action type is one value of LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and the notice states are the notice service's
    Then no person name, address, contact value or identity number is in the decision record, a log or an event

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations (not a legacy criterion)
    Given the provided operations of rwb-litigation are called
    When a call carries no credential, a role without the right, or an unknown legal action
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 for those three cases in that order

  Scenario: AC8 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (not a legacy criterion; BR7)
    Given the legal action LA-2026-000501 is written with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same Idempotency-Key is sent again
    Then the write happens once, one notice is requested and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC9 Activity retry and timeout (not a legacy criterion)
    Given LitigationWorkflow runs the step as one activity
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then the decision record is written once and a timed-out attempt leaves the legal action unchanged

  Scenario: AC10 Consumed call fails or does not answer (not a legacy criterion; BR3 and BR5)
    Given the rwb-comms contract mock fails or does not answer
    When the step asks for the notice
    Then the stage stays at NOTICE_GENERATED and the legal action LA-2026-000501 is unchanged

edits.new: BR8 and BR9 are covered by AC6; their test row is TC-E5-001-10 in section 16.
